summary.text: Tom Herner is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Tom Young.
An auditor by profession, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include cost-of-living relief, public school funding and reproductive rights.

paragraphs.text: Tom Herner graduated from Centerville City High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Wright State University in 2021.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his degree is in entrepreneurship with a minor in computer science and that he has more than a decade of experience in internal auditing, banking and entrepreneurship.
Herner said he would seek property tax relief by expanding the Homestead Exemption, support first-time homebuyer programs and affordable child care, and return to the Fair School Funding Plan.
He also named reproductive rights and government ethics and accountability as policy priorities.
